# README.md

Source: https://github.com/vovchic17/aiosend/blob/dev/README.md

<p align="center"> <!-- markdownlint-disable MD033 MD041 MD045 MD013-->

  <h1 align="center">aiosend</h1>
</p>


**aiosend** is a synchronous & asynchronous [Crypto Pay API](https://help.send.tg/en/articles/10279948-crypto-pay-api) client.

> ## [Official documentation](https://aiosend.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
>
> ## [<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vovchic17/static/main/src/telegram_logo.svg" width="30" align="top">  Telegram chat](https://aiosend.t.me/)

## Quick start

```python
import asyncio
from aiosend import CryptoPay


async def main():
    cp = CryptoPay(token="TOKEN")
    app = await cp.get_me()
    print(app.name)  # Your App's Name


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

## aiogram 3.x integration example

```python
import asyncio
from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher
from aiosend import CryptoPay

cp = CryptoPay("TOKEN")
bot = Bot("TOKEN")
dp = Dispatcher()


@dp.message()
async def get_invoice(message):
    invoice = await cp.create_invoice(1, "USDT")
    await message.answer(f"pay: {invoice.bot_invoice_url}")
    invoice.poll(message=message)


@cp.invoice_paid()
async def handle_payment(invoice, message):
    await message.answer(f"invoice #{invoice.invoice_id} has been paid")


async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(
        dp.start_polling(bot),
        cp.start_polling(),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

# Contributing to aiosend

Source: https://github.com/vovchic17/aiosend/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md

# Contributing to aiosend

We welcome any contributions! 💖
By following these simple guidelines, you can help make **aiosend** better for everyone.

---

## Getting Started

1. Create a new branch for your changes: `git checkout -b my-feature`
2. Install project dependencies:  uv sync

---

## Reporting Issues

- If you find a bug or want to suggest a new feature, create an **issue**
or write to the Telegram group: **[aiosend](htps://t.me/aiosend)**
- Try to describe the problem in detail and provide steps to reproduce it if possible

---

## Pull Requests

- Use a separate branch for your PR
- Write clear and descriptive titles
- Describe your changes in detail
- Keep your PR focused on a single task or fix

---

## Code Style

- Follow [PEP8](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0008/)
- Use `ruff` to format code

---

## Requirements for Contributors

To contribute to the project, you should:

- Be familiar with **[Crypto Pay API](https://help.send.tg/en/articles/10279948-crypto-pay-api)**
and project [aiosend](https://aiosend.rtfd.io)
- Have knowledge of the **[Python programming language](https://www.python.org/)**
- Be motivated and willing to help improve the project

---

## License

By contributing, you agree that your changes will be
licensed under the same license as this project.

---

# Security Policy

Source: https://github.com/vovchic17/aiosend/blob/dev/SECURITY.md

# Security Policy

Security is very important to the **aiosend** project and its community. 🔒

Learn more below. 👇

## Supported Versions

The **latest version** of aiosend is supported.

It is strongly recommended to write tests for your application and regularly
update aiosend **after ensuring that all tests pass successfully**.  
This way, you can benefit from new features, bug fixes,
and, most importantly, **security updates**.

You can learn more about aiosend versions and how to pin and
update them in your project in the documentation.

## Vulnerability Disclosure

If you discover a vulnerability — **even if you are not sure that it is
a real security issue**, please report it as soon as possible.

To report a vulnerability, please contact us via the Telegram group: **[@aiosend](https://t.me/aiosend)**

Moderators and community members will help to:

- verify the issue;
- reproduce it;
- properly document the report;
- find a safe and appropriate solution.

Please try to provide as much detail as possible, including
reproduction steps and example code, if available.

## Public Discussions

Please **avoid publicly disclosing security vulnerabilities**
until the issue has been reviewed and resolved. 🙊

It is better to discuss the problem within the
community first to minimize potential impact.

---

Thank you for helping keep aiosend secure!

The **aiosend** community truly appreciates your contribution ❤️

---
